title.en: An Act Authorizing the Secretary of the Interior to Suspend for the Year Nineteen Hundred and Twenty-One the Effects of the General Revision of Assessments of Real Estate Made in the Year Nineteen Hundred and Twenty in the Regularly Organized

text.en:
The Secretary of the Interior is hereby authorized, upon petition of the council of the
municipality, approved on or before the expiration of the term for the payment of the land tax and favorably
indorsed by the provincial board concerned, to suspend in such municipality for the present year the effects of
the general revision of assessments made in the year nineteen hundred and twenty in the regularly organized

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 24, 1921.
